explication: Omarchy is a Linux distribution whose shell provides interactive desktop workflows through a configurable bar, menus, panels, notifications, and supporting tools. The tree and README establish broad capabilities; sampled source confirms selected models and behaviors, but not their QML wiring or most subsystem calls. The graph therefore preserves documented product branches while keeping unverified runtime connections dashed or omitted.
